translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: Lukas
book.title: Lele Pore Men Ia Tadulkon I LUKAS

content: Yesus nomosuu' sompulo' rua' murit-Na
Yesus nengeleelo'mo murit-Na men sompulo' rua' iya'a kasi nantarai i raaya'a kuasa bo pumbuse'i meena ka' bo pengelesi'i biai' kaliangan nggeona mian.
Ka' i Ia nomosuu' i raaya'a mae' mengelelekon Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala ka' mengelesi'i mian manggeo.
Taeni Yesus na ko'ona i raaya'a, “Alia mangawawa upa-upa na rae'anmuu, alia mangawawa tokon, kabai tuuman, kabai kakaan, kabai doi', kabai se' bokukum rurua'.
Kalu kuu tuuk na laiganna mian, ka' ia laboti mian, dodongo na laiganna pataka i kuu mamarerei kota iya'a.
Ka' kalu isian mian men bude' mangalaboti i kuu na sa'angu' kota, na tempo i kuu mamarerei kota inono', taperi a awu na palaana saratmuu bookoi oos se' i raaya'a sian kokana'na Alaata'ala.”
Kasi i raaya'a nomae' na longkop kampung pori-porimban mengelelekon Lele Pore iya'a ka' mengelesi'i mian manggeo men na biai' dodongoan.
Herodes raranga'kon i Yesus
Na tempo i Herodes men tomundo' na libutan Galilea nongorongor giigii' men nosida iya'a, ia noraranga'mo. Gause isian mian men nangaan se' i Yohanes Pansarani nipotuo'imo noko daa lapus.
Isian uga' mian men nangaan se' i Elia notakamo soosoodo. Mian sambana uga' nangaan se' sa'angu' nabii men na nabii mbaripian notuo'mo soosoodo.

Taena i Herodes, “Yaku' nomosuu'konmo mian nongkolongi takala' ni Yohanes. Kasee mian kani'i, ime i Ia men tuutuu'na? Biai'mo a lele-Na men yaku' rongor.” Mbaka' i Herodes nampari-parimo bo pootuung tii Yesus.
Yesus namakaan lima' loloon mian
Poposuu' ni Yesus nomule'konmo ka' nuntundunkon ni Yesus giigii' men ia wawau i raaya'a. Yesus nangangemo i raaya'a ka' mae' nintisaal na kota Betsaida.

Kasee mian biai' inti-inti'i se' koiya'a. Mbaka' i raaya'a nuntuntunimo i Yesus. Raaya'a ia labotimo i Yesus, kasi i Yesus nuntundunkon na ko'ona i raaya'a Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala. Ka' Ia uga' nengelesi'i mian men mingkira' malesi'.

Sarataa ilio muntumbeimo sopok, murit-Na men sompulo' rua' notakamo na Ko'ona ka' norobu taena, “Guru, tampat kani'i oloa na dodongoanna mian. Mbulo posuu' a mian karaani'i bi rae' kada' i raaya'a mansarak kakaan ka' tampat bo tuukanna na kampung men isian na libutan kani'i.”
Kasee taeni Yesus, “Kuusi a mantarai i raaya'a kakaan.” Taena murit ni Yesus, “Kai tongko' isian roti lilima' ka' susum rurua'. Kabai se' kai tio mingili kakaan bona mian biai' karaaya'a?”
(Indo'o isian toro lima' loloon mian moro'one.) Taeni Yesus na murit-Na, “Posuu' a mian karaanono' umoruang morimpung, ka' sarimpung toro limampulo' mian.”
Murit ni Yesus iya'a nongololoikonmo koi men taeni Yesus.

Komburi'na i Yesus nangalamo roti lilima' ka' susum rurua' iya'a, kasi nolumelengea' waara'a langit, ka' nobasukuur na Alaata'ala. Noko daa koiya'a Ia rumpi-rumpikmo a roti iya'a kasi nongorookon na murit-Na bo obo-oboskononna i raaya'a na mian biai'.
Raaya'a wiwi'na nobenteng nangkaan. Ka' labina roti men nikaan iya'a ia ruru' murit ni Yesus, dauga' nobuke' sampulo' rua' basung.
Petrus nompotuutuu' se' i Yesus a Tomundo' Pansalamatkon
Na sa'angu' tempo pintanga' i Yesus sambayang suungna, notakamo a murit-Na na Ko'ona. Kasi i Yesus nimikirawari i raaya'a tae-Na, “Koi taena mian biai', ime mbali' i Yaku' kani'i?”
Ia simbati i raaya'a taena, “Yohanes Pansarani. Isian sambana men mangaan ai Elia. Mian sambana soosoodo mangaan se' isian nabii tempo mbaripian men notuo'mo soosoodo.”
Yesus nimikirawarmo na ko'ona i raaya'a tae-Na, “Koi taemuu murit-Ku, ai ime i Yaku' kani'i?” Ia simbati i Petrus taena, “Tomundo' Pansalamatkon men nda'ara'amari na Alaata'ala.”
Kasi i Yesus nomotoo i raaya'a kada' alia mambantilkon ni imepo upa-upa men nosida kani'i.
Yesus nambantilkon na murit-Na se' i Ia bo papateion ka' bo potuo'ion
Ka' taeni Yesus, “Anak Manusia tio munsuri repaan biai' ka' kokundaionna motu-motu'a, tanaasna imam ka' wawa ukum Torat. Ia bo papateion, kasee na ilio kotolu'na bo potuo'ion.”
Komburi'na taeni Yesus na giigii' mian men indo'o, “Mian men mingkira' mongololo' i Yaku' tio mongkolimbo'kon pingkira'na noana, kasi mamasa'an saliipna sanda' ilio ka' mongololo' i Yaku'.
Gause mian men mampari-pari mansalamatkon wakana na dunia kani'i, ia sian mantausi tutuo' men pore. Kasee mian men mongorookon wakana bo Ingku', ia bo mantausi tutuo' men pore.
Upa mbali' a ee'na men takakononna mian mau ia montombonoi longkop tano' balaki' kasee i ia silaka' ka' sian mantausi tutuo' men pore pataka sidutu?

Kalu isian mian men makamaa' mompotuutuu' i Yaku' tia pisiso'-Ku, Anak Manusia uga' bo makamaa' mompotuutuu' mian iya'a na tempo Ia taka tia kuasa-Na ka' kuasana Tama-Na ka' kuasana malaa'ikat men molinas!
Imamat a men taeng-Ku', ka' uga' bantilkonon-Ku na ko'omuu se' isian i kuu men daa mokaraani'i men sianpo lapus kalu koo'po mimiile' Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala.”
Yesus ni'angga'i na wawona buu'na
Toro walu' ilio a noporusanna i Yesus nimisiso'kon upa-upa iya'a, Ia nangawawamo i Petrus, Yohanes, ka' i Yakobus nasawe' na wawona sa'angu' buu'na mae' sambayang.
Tempo i Yesus pintanga' sambayang inda'a, ro'up-Na nokoboliianmo ka' juba-Na nosidamo bubulak dingkalapan.
Kasi nokampiile'an a rua' mian batundun tii Ia. Mian iya'a ai Musa tii Elia.
Rua-rua' irana nintipiile' tia kobalaki'an ka' ruar men nda'ara'amari na surugaa. Raaya'a batundun tii Yesus, muntundun kolapusan-Na men sianmo manau' bo rumpakion-Na na Yerusalem.
Na tempo iya'a i Petrus tia simbaya'na tinomporoyotmo, kasee tempo i raaya'a nowangon, raaya'a nimiile' se' i Yesus nodingkalapanmo ka' uga' rua' mian iya'a men potokerer tii Ia.

Tempo rua' mian iya'a boomo mamarerei i Yesus, Petrus norobumo ni Yesus taena, “Guru, ma'amat tuu' i kita isian na tampat kani'i. Mbulo i kai momokerer sa'up totolu', sa'angu' bo Ko'omuu, sa'angu' boni Musa, ka' sa'angu' boni Elia.” (Petrus norobu koiya'a kasee sian ia inti'i a upa men ia porobukon.)
Dauga' pintanga' i Petrus morobu, notakamo a antong nansa'upi i raaya'a. Tempo ia sa'upi antong iya'a, raaya'a nolayaonmo.
Komburi'na na antong iya'a nokamporongoranmo a wurung men nangaan, “Ni'imo a Anak-Ku men Yaku' ruruki. Porongori i Ia!”
Noko daa wurung men koiya'a, ia piile' i raaya'a i Yesus somo suungna indo'o. Murit ni Yesus nompopowuni upa men nosida iya'a, ka' tempo iya'a sianpo nitundunii upa men ia piile' i raaya'a ni imepo.
Yesus nengelesi'i anak men ia lampingi meena
Koi liilana i Yesus tia murit-Na totolu' notumokurumo na buu'na iya'a, ka' mian biai' notakamo na Ko'ona.
Sa'angu' moro'one men isian na mian biai' iya'a nengeleelo'kon taena, “Guru, miki piile'kon anakku. Ia anakku men sa'a-sa'angu'!
Kalu meena mangalampingi i ia, ia liuliu mangkakaro' ka' meena iya'a munggugurkon i ia pataka wura'on a nganga'na. Meena iya'a sinampang mampapolosi i ia ka' bude' mamarerei i ia.
Yaku' niki tulungmo na murit-Muu kada' mumbuse'ikon meena iya'a, kasee sian ia poko i raaya'a nibuse'i.”

Taeni Yesus, “Alia uga' i kuu mian men tumuo' na tempo koini'i! Kuu tuutuu' mian men sian parasaya ka' men nosala'mo salan. Pataka ipi mbali' i Yaku' tio dumodongo tii kuu ka' mokotaan na upa men wawauonmuu? Wawa le'emari anakmuu kanono'!”

Pintanga' anak iya'a waale'e ni Yesus, meena iya'a ningirimpa'konmo na tano' ka' nunggugurkon i ia. Kasee i Yesus nengerengeaki meena iya'a ka' nengelesi'i anak iya'a. Kasi i Yesus nungule'kon anak iya'a na tamana.

Giigii' mian samba' nimiile' kuasana Alaata'ala men balaki' tuu'. Kopirinduanna i Yesus nambantilkon na murit-Na se' i Ia bo papateion ka' bo potuo'ion 9:43b-45 (Mat. 17:22-23; Mrk. 9:30-32) Na tempo mian biai' dauga' samba' tuu' mimiile' giigii' men ia wawau i Yesus, Ia norobumo na murit-Na tae-Na,
“Rongor ka' intoomkon pore-pore a wurung-Ku kani'imari. Anak Manusia bo rookonon na kuasana mian.”
Kasee murit ni Yesus sian ninginti'i upa men Ia wurungkon, gause aratina niwunikon na ko'ona i raaya'a dako' inti'ionna i raaya'a. Kasee i raaya'a babata mimikirawar ni Yesus aratina wurung-Na iya'a.
Ime a balaki'na na giigii' murit
Murit ni Yesus nopoogagaimo munsurung se' ime a men balaki'na i raaya'a.
Yesus ninginti'i pikiranna i raaya'a, mbali' Ia nangalamo sa'angu' anak morio' kasi Ia pokerer a anak iya'a na soripi'-Na.

Kasi i Ia norobu na murit-Na tae-Na, “Ime a men mangalaboti anak kani'i gause mian iya'a mongololo' pisiso'-Ku, nono' a men ngaanon mangalaboti i Yaku'. Ka' ime a men mangalaboti i Yaku', mian iya'a uga' mangalaboti i Ia men nomosuu' i Yaku'. Gause mian men morio'na, iamo a men balaki'na.”
Mian men taasi' murit ni Yesus numbuse'i meena
Taena i Yohanes, “Guru! Kai nimiile' mian numbuse'i meena see mangaan ngaan-Muu a numbuse'ina, mbaka' kai kokundakonmo i ia gause i ia taasi' tii kita.”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Alia mongkokundakon i ia! Gause mian men daa sian mangka'idek i kuu, nono' aratina umapak na ko'omuu.”
Sa'angu' kampung na Samaria men sian nangalaboti i Yesus
Sarataa karani'mo a tempo ni Yesus bo nakaton waara'a surugaa, Ia namakadodormo noa-Na se' i Ia bo mae' na Yerusalem.
Mbaka' i Ia nomosuu'mo mian mae' mongolukoni i Ia. Raaya'a men niposuu' nomae'mo, kasi ninsoop na sa'angu' kampungna lipu' Samaria bo montoropotikon giigii' bo Ko'ona.
Kasee mian na kampung iya'a bude' nangalaboti i Yesus, gause noka'inti'ianmo se' i Ia banta-bantang mae' na Yerusalem.

Mbaka' na tempo rua' murit ni Yesus men i Yakobus ka' i Yohanes ninginti'i upa men nosida iya'a, raaya'a norobumo na Ko'ona taena, “Tumpu, kalu poturangon-Muu, kai mama'ase' kada' apu malau nda'ara'amari langit bo pinsilaka'i raaya'a.”
Kasee i Yesus noluminga ka' nongkokundakon i raaya'a.
Kasi i raaya'a nomae' na kampung sambana.
Toropii mian men mingkira' sida murit ni Yesus
Na tempo i Yesus ka' murit-Na ningimputkonmo rae'anna soosoodo, isian mian men nangaan ni Yesus taena, “Yaku' mingkira' mongololo' i Kuu mau maana a rae'an-Muu!”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Serigala isian bolo'na, ka' sapu' isian pimpeetaanna, kasee Anak Manusia sianta bo tokolan-Na.”
Kasi i Yesus norobu na sa'angu' mian men sambana tae-Na, “Lolo'mo i Yaku'.” Kasee mian iya'a norobu taena, “Poturang i yaku' mule'kon kutung mae' mantanom tamangku.”
Ia simbati i Yesus tae-Na, “Patalai a mian lapus mantanom mianna i raaya'a men nolapusmo. Kasee i koo, rae' ka' lelekon a lelena Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala.”
Isian uga' mian sambana men nangaan taena, “Tumpu, yaku' mingkira' mongololo' i Kuu, kasee poturang i yaku' mule'kon kutung mae' mobantil na poto'utusanku.”
Kasee taeni Yesus na mian iya'a, “Mian men muntumbeimo bapajeko kasee mingilinga na komburi', ia sian kokana'-Ku bo mianna Batomundo'anna Alaata'ala.”
